patch_description: The current parent selector samples uniformly from the archive almost half the time, so it can repeatedly spend LP calls exploring the same regions while neglecting promising, under-visited networks. Track parent selection counts and weight selection by a blend of LP rank, low visit count, and structural isolation from other archive members. This retains preference for strong networks while directing more search toward underexplored regions; the existing stall counter provides an additional bonus to parents whose neighborhoods have not recently improved.
